# Rating sample provenance

- **Crew Girl / Douban subject 37516033**: live Wikidata claims captured on 2026-11-16 from [Q141155312](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q141155312). The entity is a series (`P31=Q5398426`) with IMDb ID `tt38218082`, and has no RT ID (`P1258`), Metacritic ID (`P1712`), or Douban ID (`P4529`). The live rendered-page observation supplied for this review noted that RT and Metacritic Season 1 pages show scores, but those pages are intentionally not requested by the fixture because the work-to-source mapping is absent. This sample tests the strict mapping-missing boundary; it does not infer either page's ID or claim a source no-rating result.
- **The Altruists**: live Wikidata claims captured on 2026-11-16 from [Q135470331](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q135470331), including series type, IMDb ID, Metacritic slug, and planned start date 2026-11-19. The rendered Metacritic page at [`/tv/the-altruists/`](https://www.metacritic.com/tv/the-altruists/) was observed before release with “Critic reviews are not available yet”, canonical and TVSeries JSON-LD, and no `aggregateRating`. Its runtime fixture uses a test-only Douban subject ID because the Wikidata item has no `P4529`; the fixture exercises the actual Metacritic parser through SubjectPageRuntime, and only that parser-confirmed outcome is labeled source-no-rating.

These are dated source snapshots, not claims that the pages or values remain unchanged. Fixture files retain only the claims or rendered fields needed by the runtime regression.
